'''Nim Bola''' was a freelance [[Detective/Legends|detective]] for hire operating on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He partnered with a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] named [[Tavri]].

==Biography==
Bola operated on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and frequented [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Mos Eisley Cantina]]. At one point, he was followed by a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] and [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], but led them into a dark alley where he was able to ambush them. He went to the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Pit of Carkoon]] to dispose of their corpses. While there, he came across the remains of an [[Ambassador-class shuttle|''Ambassador''-class shuttle]] carrying [[Tereb Ab'Lon]] and the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-Z1]]. He managed to free the droid from the wreckage and was asked by Ab'Lon to take the droid to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Bola decided to sell the droid to the highest bidder, and tossed the grievously injured Ab'Lon to the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlaac]]. He later met a group of Rebels to arrange the sale of the droid for 50,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="DT" />

Bola hid the droid at his home but was captured by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. A group of Rebels arrived on Tatooine to pick up the droid, but were informed by Tavril that they would have to assist him in freeing Bola from Imperial confinement before he would reveal the location of the droid. Tavril had the group place explosives on the militia building where Bola was being held. He rescued Bola in the confusion caused by the explosives and the pair fled the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="AJ4">{{JournalCite|4|A Deal Gone Sour}}</ref>
